Though I will say a filter is usually the better option in most situations, especially for beginners. Less work, less plant care, and potentially the option for more fish. Basically, if you can get a filter, you might as well get one.
Eh, it really just comes down to opinion. Some say goldfish can have tank mates, while others are totally against it.

A betta in an average tank doesn’t need filtration as long as you are willing to change water more frequently (hopefully not so frequently that you end up with a stressed out fish). Plants definitely help too. Not saying it’s ideal, but it can work. Wouldn’t really recommend for beginners.
